name: py-windows-syscall-bench
description: Benchmark for evaluating LLM chain-of-thought reasoning that links a Python source line to the Windows native syscall it triggers, judged against curated ground truth.

task_format.input: Curated prompt unit: target code line, surrounding context, and syscall trace.
task_format.ground_truth: Best curated answer plus all candidate answers and the selection rationale.
task_format.prediction: One JSON line per evaluated model with its raw answer.

reference.description: Static stdlib-function -> Windows NtAPI truth map; the ground-truth source the per-task data is validated against.
